IITB Project Recruitment:
Project title: Technical Group on Superconducting Quantum Computers
About the project: This project is about establishing materials and processes for advanced packaging
integration for quantum computing, particularly for superconducting qubits. In addition, innovations in
integration of classical electronic elements in the packaging, without disturbing the qubits are also
being explored. Material optimization, analysis, and device physics expertise as well as device
fabrications is are major efforts.
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
Ph.D. in Physics (Specialization in Semiconductor Physics / Nanotechnology/ Material science).
Desirable Skills and Experience:
• Hands-on experience in nano/micro-fabrication within Class 100 clean room environments,
including ALD, PVD (magnetron sputtering, e-beam evaporation, PLD, Laser MBE), RIE,
photolithography and thermal oxidation.
• Proficiency in electrical characterization of semiconductor devices using Keithley 4200A
parameter analyzer,Keysight probe station, cryogenic probe stations (4.2 K) and ferroelectric testers
(Aixacct TF Analyzer).
• Expertise in materials characterization techniques including XPS, HAXPES, PEEM, RHEED,
XRD, SEM, TEM, EDX, AFM, Raman Spectroscopy, FTIR and UV-Vis Spectroscopy.
• Demonstrated capability in device simulation and layout design using Klayout, Optiwave and
GINESTRA (Applied materials) software.
Strongly Desirable Skill:
• Expertise in fabrication and characterization of HfO₂/ZrO₂-based ferroelectric capacitors
(FeCAPs), ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) and ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs), with
in-depth understanding of oxygen vacancy dynamics, domain pinning, polarization switching and
fatigue recovery mechanisms.
• Significant experience as a User Principal Investigator (PI) at international synchrotron facilities
(SOLEIL, NSLS-II, Spring8, Elettra etc.) utilizing Hard X-ray, Photoelectron Spectroscopy
(HAXPES), X-ray Photoemission Electron Microscopy (XPEEM) and operando depth profiling
techniques for electronic band lineup and chemical state analysis.
• Knowledge of Back-End-of-Line (BEOL) compatible hafnia-based ferroelectrics, nanosecond
laser annealing (NLA) and interface engineering for advanced logic and memory applications.
• First-author publications in high-impact journals and work presentations at international
conferences (IEDM, E-MRS, SSDM, NVMTs, etc.
Job Profile:
Key responsibilities include:
• Optimize deposition and processing parameters to control oxygen vacancy distribution in
channel-encapsulated ITO FETs, CMOS devices and non-filamentary
RRAM. Investigate trap states, vacancy migration and charge trapping/detrapping mechanisms at
oxide-semiconductor and metal-oxide interfaces using electrical and spectroscopic techniques.
• Design, fabricate and characterize BEOL-compatible hafnia-based ferroelectric capacitors
(FeCAPs) with Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂ (HZO) thin films. Investigate
ferroelectric stability and polarization-dependent oxygen vacancy redistribution in HfO₂/ZrO₂
superlattices and ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs), including
nanosecond laser annealing process optimization.
• Conduct in-operando and ex-situ characterization using synchrotron-based HAXPES and
XPEEM for depth profiling of physical chemistry, electronic band lineup, and oxygen vacancy
concentration profiles in ultra-thin (10 nm) ferroelectric films. Perform parallel imaging of multiple
FeCAPs on PEEM platforms to understand cycling-voltage dependence of vacancy generation and
mobility.
• Serve as User Principal Investigator (PI) for international synchrotron beamtime experiments,
leading independent research proposals, coordinating multi-institutional collaborations, and executing
time-resolved and spatially-resolved spectroscopic measurements at facilities including SOLEIL
(France), NSLS-II (USA), Spring8 (Japan), DAISY (Germany), Diamond (Germany), MAX-IV
(Sweden) and Elettra (Italy).
• Lead the preparation of peer-reviewed manuscripts for high-impact journals, present research
at international symposia (IEDM, VLSI, E-MRS, SSDM, NVMTs, etc.) and contribute to patent filings
for novel device architectures and fabrication methodologies.

IITB Project Recruitment:
Project title: Wafer-scale Emitter and Detector Arrays for Multi-wavelength Room Temperature
Photonic QuantumTechnologies
About the project: The project, supported under the National Quantum Mission (NQM), focuses on
the development of wafer-scale two-dimensional (2D) materials for quantum emitters and detectors.
The computational research will involve the design and optimisation of precursors for 2D material
growth, defect engineering for controlled quantum emission, and the prediction of structure-property
relationships using periodic density functional theory (DFT) calculations and machine learning (ML)
techniques. The work aims to identify promising material compositions, precursors and defect
configurations to guide experimental synthesis and optimise the performance of 2D quantum devices.
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
Ph.D. in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Computational Materials Science or a related
discipline, or equivalent qualifications as per the applicable Research Associate recruitment
guidelines.
Candidates should have a strong background in computational materials science, particularly
electronic structure calculations and modelling of solid-state or two-dimensional materials.
Experience in periodic density functional theory (DFT) calculations, including defect modelling,
surface chemistry or reaction mechanisms, is highly desirable. Proficiency in Python programming
and demonstrated experience in machine learning (ML) techniques for materials modelling and
property prediction are preferred. Familiarity with computational packages such as VASP, Quantum
ESPRESSO or related electronic structure codes, along with a good publication record, will be an
advantage.
Candidates with demonstrated experience in periodic DFT calculations, Python programming and
machine learning applications to materials science will be preferred. Prior experience in 2D materials,
defect engineering, precursor chemistry or high-throughput computational screening will be an added
advantage. Applicants may be asked to provide relevant publications and details of their
computational experience.
Job Profile:
The selected candidate will perform periodic DFT calculations and develop machine learning models
for the design and optimisation of 2D materials for quantum emitter applications. The work will
involve computational screening of precursors for wafer-scale growth of 2D materials, modelling of
defects and dopants, investigating defect formation energies and electronic properties, and
identifying suitable defect configurations for quantum emission. The candidate will also develop
Python-based computational workflows, integrate DFT calculations with ML approaches for
accelerated materials discovery, and collaborate with experimental researchers to validate
computational predictions and guide material synthesis.
Pay Details:
Consolidated Salary Rs. 67000 + HRA (as applicable) p.m.

About the project: The project funded by the Government focuses on developing and demonstrating
drone and allied technologies. The project will address various applications through the utilization of

IITB Recruiting:
IIT Bombay, an Institute of National Importance adjudged as Institute of Eminence, was established
in 1958 as a part of the government initiative, by an Act of Parliament 1961. The Institute invites
online application from Indian Citizens having requisite qualification(s) and experience for one
position of Registrar post on Deputation / Tenure for a period of five years.
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
Applicants with the following essential qualification(s) and mandatory experience can apply to the
post of Registrar at IIT Bombay:
Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade point average with administrative
experience of fifteen years, out of which eight years as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post at Pay
Level 12 (78800- 209200) and above or equivalent, and should have demonstrated ability to
supervise digitalized administration. The administrative experience at PL 12 and above should
include at least four years in Academic / Government/ Semi-Government R&D Organisation.
Desirable:
• Any additional degree or diploma in Management/ Law or a Ph.D. from recognized University/
Institute.
• Candidates should preferably have a first-class (60% or equivalent grade and above) academic
record from the 10th standard onwards.
• Proven ability in administration, preferably in a large educational or research institution, financial or
personal management with the capacity to lead administration in a residential R&D institution.
• Competence in computer skills and all forms of communication
Job Profile:
Registrar is responsible for administration of various wings of IIT Bombay as per policy guidelines
framed by the Director and Board of Governors. IIT Bombay is recognised worldwide as a leader in
the field of engineering education and research and Institute of Eminence in India. Thus, the
Registrar is expected to have positive attitude with problem solving capabilities. The Registrar is
responsible for overall coordination and leading a team of officers from various wings, for better
management of administrative, academic, financial, procurement, security and legal matters of the
Institute, in conjunction with Institute functionaries. Under the Act, the Registrar is the custodian of
records, the common seal and funds of the Institute. The Registrar is ex-officio secretary to the Board
of Governors and the Senate. Therefore, the thorough knowledge of Government rules and
regulations, applicable to Indian Higher Education Institutions is desirable
Pay Details:
Pay Level 14 (144200 - 218200)
The post carries usual allowances at par with those admissible under IIT Bombay rules in the
corresponding pay matrix.
Age limit: 55 years (on the application closing date)
General information:
I) How to apply:
a) Applicants possessing the requisite qualification(s) and relevant experience may apply online at
the following links:
a. https://www.iitb.ac.in/career/apply
b. https://ep.iitb.ac.in/jobsearch#
The hard /soft copy of the application form submitted online in the application portal is not required to
be sent by post/ email. The soft copy of the application/resume sent over e-mail to any Institute
Officials will not be considered for the selection process.
b) The application fee is Rs. 500 (Non- Refundable) for General Category candidates. For OBC
(NCL) & EWS candidates, the application fee is Rs. 250 (Non-refundable). The application fee is to
be paid online through the application portal before submitting the application. Moreover, no fee is
payable by SC, ST, PwDs, and Female candidates.

scrutinized, and only scrutiny-in applicants will be called for further selection process. Merely fulfilling
the requirements prescribed in the advertisement will not automatically entitle an applicant to be
called for the further selection process. It may not be possible and / or convenient to conduct the
shortlisting process for all eligible applicants, and under such circumstances, the Institute can limit
the number of applicants to be called for shortlisting process on the basis of qualifications and / or
experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. Hence, applicants should give
all relevant details of qualification and experience with supporting documents, if any.
b) Selection Process tentatively comprises of Presentation and /or Interview. The method of selection
indicated above is purely tentative and is subject to such revision as may be felt necessary by the
Institute. Candidates are advised to keep visiting institute website regularly for further update.
III) Terms and conditions for applying:
a) The applicants should ensure at their end that they possess the essential qualification(s) and
experience laid down .for the post. The qualifying degree(s) must be from a recognized University /
Institute.
b) Details furnished in the online application will be treated as final, and no subsequent changes shall
be entertained.
c) In case of recruitment by deputation, the shortlisted candidates shall submit through proper
channel, duly certified copies of Annual Confidential Report (ACR)/Annual Performance Assessment
Report (APAR), should have at least an overall grading of "Very Good" in the past five APARs/ACRs
starting from 2021 - 22 and Vigilance clearance certificate & certificate showing Major or Minor
penalties, if any, imposed from the competent authority of the organization where they are serving.
d) Since the post advertised is earmarked for Deputation (including Tenure) and the maximum age
